h: Saraki mourns driver who served him for almost 30 years
p: Former Senate President Bukola Saraki has announced the death of Williams Odumosu, who was his driver for nearly three decades. He said losing him so soon after his retirement was painful.
body: Former Senate President Bukola Saraki has announced the death of Williams Odumosu, who worked as his personal driver for almost 30 years.

In a social media post, Saraki said he received the news of Odumosu's death on Saturday, 14 November 2026. He said his former driver had only recently retired, and that he had hoped he would have many years ahead to rest and enjoy time with his family.
He described losing him so soon after retirement as deeply painful.
After returning to Abuja, Saraki personally visited Odumosu's family to offer his condolences.
more: Odumosu drove Saraki for almost 30 years.
Saraki visited the family in Abuja.
